translatorNotes: Register: informal tú throughout, consistent with the rest of the es effort.

FLAG — RFQ terminology: 'RFQ' kept as the acronym and glossed once on first use as 'solicitud de cotización (RFQ)'. Whether to keep 'RFQ' or switch to 'pedido de cotización' / 'solicitud de presupuesto' should be confirmed for the target market before publishing (Spain tends to 'presupuesto'; Latin America 'cotización').

Manufacturing glossary applied consistently: quote -> cotización, estimator -> estimador, shop -> taller, shop floor -> planta, purchase order -> orden de compra, supplier -> proveedor, lead time/delivery date -> fecha de entrega, specs -> especificaciones, drawing -> plano. 'X min read' -> 'X min de lectura'.
ERP/MRP/CRM/CPQ/CAD/PDF acronyms kept as-is. Brand names kept exact: n8n, Make, Zapier, Innovaria Tech, Innovaria Tech Limited, Ahsan Ilyas.

'August 7, 2026' -> '7 de agosto de 2026'. article:section 'Manufacturing Automation' -> 'Automatización para manufactura'. Kicker 'Manufacturing' -> 'Manufactura'.
